title: XGrammar-2: Efficient Dynamic Structured Generation Engine for Agentic LLMs
relevance_note: Structured-generation paper targeting dynamic tool-calling and response protocols.
reason_included: High-value source for grammar-enforced invocation and runtime overhead control.

claim_snippets.claim_text: Experiments report more than 6x faster grammar compilation than prior structured-generation engines with near-zero end-to-end overhead.
It introduces TagDispatch for dynamic structure switching and Cross-Grammar Cache for substructure-level reuse across grammars.
The engine combines an Earley-based adaptive token mask cache, JIT compilation, and repetition state compression to reduce dynamic-grammar overhead.
XGrammar-2 targets dynamic structured generation workloads such as tool calling and response protocols where structure can vary across and within requests.
